faqs.a: The AI studio for content creators — 36 tools that write your songs, shoot your videos, cut your promo, design your brand, and run your business. One account, one Visual Buc system, no team required.

Visual Bucs are the fuel. You buy them in packs starting at $9, and every AI generation spends a few — a full song is 400 Visual Bucs, a music video is 400, a hook idea is 100. Browsing, editing, and viewing are always free. Payments are in test mode right now, so nothing real is charged.

faqs.q: What does a full release cost?
faqs.a: A song (400 VB) + a music video (400 VB) + promo clips (100 VB) + a hook pack (100 VB) = 1,000 Visual Bucs. The entire release pipeline — song to promo — for less than the cost of one pack.

faqs.q: Do I need experience to use it?
faqs.a: No. Describe your vision in plain words — genre, mood, artist, idea — and the studio handles the craft. Advanced controls are there when you want them, never in your way when you don't.

faqs.q: Can I use what I generate commercially?
faqs.a: Yes. Songs, videos, artwork, copy — what you generate is yours to release, sell, and promote anywhere.
We're in beta and shipping constantly — new tools land all the time. Payments are in test mode while we polish, so explore the studio freely.
Because it feels like one. Your competitors will think you hired a team. You didn't — you just got here first.

0.title: Create the Discord application
0.body: Open the Discord Developer Portal → New Application → name it “Bow Down Visuals”. Copy the Application ID (General Information) — that's your DISCORD_CLIENT_ID.

1.title: Create the bot user
1.body: Go to Bot → Reset Token → copy the token — that's DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN. No privileged intents needed; leave them off.

2.title: Install the bot on your server
2.body: Click “Install bot on your server” below (or paste your server, channel, and role IDs in the form). You need Manage Server permission.

3.title: Set the environment variables
3.body: On the bot service AND the api-server: DISCORD_CLIENT_ID, DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN (bot only), DISCORD_BOT_SHARED_SECRET (both, 32+ random chars — generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`).

4.title: Run the database migration
4.body: Run lib/db/migrations/0029_discord_bot.sql against production Postgres once, then deploy. The bot announces from your next Go Live.

llcGuide.chatEmpty: No questions yet — ask your first one below. Try “Do I need an LLC as a streamer?”
llcGuide.checklist10Detail: File your annual/biennial report and pay the ongoing state fee on time. Missing them can dissolve your LLC — set a calendar reminder now.
llcGuide.checklist1Detail: For 95% of creators, your home state is the right answer. Filing in Delaware or Wyoming while living elsewhere usually means paying for a foreign LLC registration in your home state too.
llcGuide.checklist2Detail: Search your Secretary of State's business name database. Your LLC name must be unique in that state and usually has to include “LLC” or “Limited Liability Company”.
llcGuide.checklist3Detail: Someone with a physical address in the state who can receive legal mail. You can be your own agent for free (your address becomes public record) or hire a service (~$100–$300/yr).
llcGuide.checklist4Detail: The one document that creates your LLC. File online with the Secretary of State and pay the state filing fee — see the fee table below for your state.
llcGuide.checklist5Detail: Even solo creators should have one — it defines ownership, how money moves, and what happens if you add a partner. Templates work for single-member LLCs.
llcGuide.checklist6Detail: Your federal tax ID. Free directly from IRS.gov — never pay a service for this. You'll need it for the bank account and tax filings.
llcGuide.checklist6Title: Get an EIN from the IRS
llcGuide.checklist7Detail: Keep business money separate from personal money from day one. Bring your approved Articles, EIN letter, and ID to the bank.
llcGuide.checklist8Detail: Most creators don't need special licenses, but check your city/county. If you sell merch, you may need a sales tax permit in your state.
llcGuide.checklist9Detail: Track every dollar in and out. A spreadsheet works at first; accounting software pays for itself once brand deals and royalties start flowing.
llcGuide.checklistComplete: 🎉 Checklist complete — you're running a real business. Bow down.
llcGuide.creatorTypeLabel: What kind of creator are you?

llcGuide.creditNotePlan: {{cost}} Visual Buc per plan · powered by Thy Cheat Code · Visual Buc refunded if the AI fails
llcGuide.disclaimerBody: This guide (including AI answers) is for informational purposes only and doesn't create an attorney–client relationship. LLC rules, fees, and tax treatment vary by state and change over time — verify everything with your Secretary of State and consult a licensed business attorney or CPA for your situation.
llcGuide.errAnswer: Couldn't get an answer — try again.
llcGuide.faq1A: Not on day one — but once you're earning real money (brand deals, ad revenue, royalties, merch), an LLC separates your personal assets from business liability and makes you look professional to sponsors. Many creators form one once they cross a few thousand dollars a year in income.
llcGuide.faq1Q: Do I actually need an LLC as a content creator?
llcGuide.faq2A: A sole proprietor IS you — no separation, so a lawsuit or debt can reach your personal assets. An LLC is a separate legal entity: business debts and most lawsuits stop at the company. LLCs also unlock business bank accounts and cleaner taxes as you grow.
llcGuide.faq2Q: LLC vs. sole proprietor — what's the difference?
llcGuide.faq3A: Almost certainly not. If you live and work in your home state, you'll still have to register there as a “foreign LLC” — paying both states' fees. The out-of-state hype mostly benefits the formation companies selling it. File where you live.
llcGuide.faq3Q: Should I file in Delaware, Wyoming, or Nevada instead of my home state?
llcGuide.faq4A: By default the IRS treats a single-member LLC like a sole proprietor: profits flow to your personal tax return (pass-through taxation). No double tax. As income grows, some creators elect S-corp taxation to save on self-employment tax — that's a conversation for a CPA.
llcGuide.faq5A: The state filing fee is the only mandatory cost — $35 to $500 depending on your state (see the table). Add the ongoing annual fee ($0–$800/yr depending on state). An EIN is free from the IRS. Budget services will happily charge you hundreds extra — you don't need them for a standard filing.
llcGuide.faq5Q: How much does it really cost?
llcGuide.faq6A: Yes, in every state. It's free. The tradeoff: your name and address go on public record, and you must be available at that address during business hours to receive legal documents. Many creators start DIY and switch to a service later.
llcGuide.faq6Q: Can I be my own registered agent?
llcGuide.faq7A: Online filings are often approved in days (Colorado can be same-day); mailed filings take weeks. Check the processing column in the fee table for your state.

privacy.pageDescription: How Bow Down Visuals handles your data.
privacy.section1Body: Bow Down Visuals operates a digital creator platform that provides AI-powered Visual Bucs for generating videos, music, images, voiceovers, lip-synced videos, lyrics, captions, thumbnails, promo clips, and related digital content. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information.
privacy.section2Item1Body: email address and password (hashed) when you register, or basic profile information from Google if you sign in with Google
privacy.section2Item2Body: handled entirely by Stripe — we never store raw card data
privacy.section2Item3Body: Visual Buc usage, tool interactions, and generated content prompts
privacy.section2Item4Body: info you enter to personalize AI outputs (artist name, genre, style preferences)
privacy.section2Item5Body: referral codes used at signup and referral rewards earned
privacy.section2Item6Body: browser type, IP address, and session data for security and performance
privacy.section3Item1: To operate and improve the platform
privacy.section3Item2: To process payments and manage subscriptions
privacy.section3Item3: To personalize AI-generated outputs to your artist profile
privacy.section3Item4: To send account-related emails (receipts, security alerts)
privacy.section4Intro: We do not sell your personal data. We share data only with:
privacy.section4Item3Body: if you sign in with Google (subject to Google's privacy policy)
privacy.section4Item4Body: to fulfill generation requests (prompts may be processed by third-party AI APIs)
privacy.section4Item5: Law enforcement when required by applicable law
privacy.section5Body: We use session cookies necessary for authentication. We do not run third-party ad trackers. Analytics, if used, are limited to aggregate usage data.
privacy.section6Body: We retain your account data for as long as your account is active. You may request deletion at any time by contacting us. Billing records are retained as required by law.
privacy.section7Intro: Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal data. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at
privacy.section8Body: We use industry-standard security measures including encrypted connections (HTTPS), hashed passwords, and row-level security on our database. No system is 100% secure; use a strong unique password for your account.
privacy.section9Body: We may update this policy from time to time. We'll notify you of material changes via email or an in-app notice.

worldThemePacks.goldenMarbleTagline: The house theme — ivory palace by day, black marble throne by night
worldThemePacks.goldenMarbleDescription: The site's own skin: golden white marble and antique gold in the light, golden black marble in the dark. The world Bow Down Visuals was built in.
worldThemePacks.sharkTankTagline: The King's waters — deep-sea marble, gold trim
worldThemePacks.sharkTankDescription: The waters around the throne: deep blue-black marble in the dark, pale sea-glass marble in the light — the antique-gold system untouched, on the King Shark's home turf. Pairs with the 8-Bit Shark cursor.
worldThemePacks.goldenHourTagline: Sunset over the plaza — ember marble, hot gold
worldThemePacks.goldenHourDescription: The plaza at golden hour: ember-bronze marble and the hottest gold in the house in the dark, warming to champagne marble by day. Pairs with the Flame cursor.
worldThemePacks.kingsSetTagline: The flagship — blackest marble, brightest gold
worldThemePacks.kingsSetDescription: Built on the approved King's Set: the blackest marble and the brightest gold leaf in the dark, the brightest ivory and deepest antique bronze by day. Pairs with the King's Crown cursor.
worldThemePacks.arcadeGoldTagline: Cheat-code charcoal, hot gold, ember glow
worldThemePacks.arcadeGoldDescription: The cheat-code side of the palace: warm charcoal marble, hot gold, and an ember underglow in the dark — warm paper marble and deep bronze by day. Pairs with the Game Controller cursor.
worldThemePacks.crimsonMarbleDescription: The palace cut in red stone: crimson-veined black marble and antique gold in the dark — blush ivory marble and deep crimson by day. Pairs with the Diamond cursor.
worldThemePacks.sapphireMarbleDescription: The palace cut in blue stone: sapphire-veined blue-black marble with platinum silver in the dark — pale ice-blue marble and deep sapphire by day. Pairs with the Gold Star cursor.
